Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Histology: Part 1: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) [AND]  with histologic confirmation of adenocarcinoma
Adenocarcinoma with small-cell  [OR] or neuroendocrine features is allowed

right.raw_text: mCRPC is defined by prostate Cancer Working Group (PCWG )3 criteria

left.raw_text:
Part 2: mCRPC  [OR] as defined above or pathologically confirmed metastatic renal cell carcinoma (RCC) as defined by world health organization (WHO)
     2016 Classifications
  -  Measurable  [OR] or evaluable disease: Part 1: Either measurable  [OR] or evaluable disease for prostate cancer

right.raw_text: Part 2: At least one measurable lesion as per RECIST v1

-  Evidence of disease progression on prior therapy that requires a new line of treatment
  -  Participants with accessible lesions enrolled in selected pharmacokinetic (PK)/pharmacodynamics (PD) cohorts and in Part 2 must agree to undergo the mandatory fresh tumor biopsies, unless collection of the biopsy presents a safety risk
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  At least 2 weeks between prior anticancer treatment (including radiotherapy) discontinuation and the first dose of study drug, and toxicities have returned to Grade less than or equal to (<=) 1  [OR] or baseline
  -  Prior treatment with prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-targeted therapy except for PSMA-targeted vaccine is permitted
  -  Solid organ  [OR] or bone marrow transplantation
  -  Seizure  [OR] or known condition that may predispose to seizure  [OR] or intracranial masses
  -  Other active malignancy requiring systemic treatment <=12 months prior to enrollment
